Load libraries and files with the cluster classification

```{r setting-up}
library(track2KBA) # load package
library(dplyr)
#library(tictoc)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(raster)
library(data.table)

#Function to change longitude
transform_longitude_vector <- function(lons) {
  sapply(lons, function(lon) ifelse(lon < 0, lon + 360, lon))
}

```
Run KBA for all PB females identified without considering the seasons

```{r match-the-clusters}
PBFemales <- read_csv("../results/PB_Clusters.csv")
col2keep <- c('TOPPID','clusterAll')
PBFemales <- PBFemales[,col2keep]

# Load the tracking data
data <- read.csv("../data/NESETracks6h.csv")
data$longitude <- transform_longitude_vector(data$longitude) # Shift to 0 - 360
range(data$longitude)
#data$longitude <- data$longitude - 256 # ShiftLong  to avoid issues with the IDL
c2 <- c("FieldID","track_id","JulDate","longitude","latitude","Season","date_gmt", "time_gmt" )
data <- data[,c2]
colnames(data) <- c("FieldID","TOPPID","JulDate","longitude","latitude","Season","date_gmt", "time_gmt" )

# Match the clusters to the tracks
data <- data %>% semi_join(PBFemales, by = 'TOPPID')
  

```

First step of the analysis
```{r run-the-home-range-analyses}
### FIRST STEP, RUN THE ANALYSIS FOR THE WHOLE POPULATION
# Prepare the data for analysis
NESE.data <- formatFields(
  dataGroup = data, 
  fieldID   = "TOPPID", 
  fieldDate = "date_gmt", 
  fieldTime = "time_gmt",
  fieldLon  = "longitude", 
  fieldLat  = "latitude"
)


# Identify Año Nuevo as a colony
colony <- NESE.data %>% 
  summarise(
    Longitude = first(Longitude), 
    Latitude  = first(Latitude)
  )

# Identify the individual trips
NESE.trips <- tripSplit(
  dataGroup  = NESE.data,
  colony     = colony,
  innerBuff  = 100,      # kilometers
  returnBuff = 100,
  duration   = 100,      # hours
  rmNonTrip  = TRUE
)

# Creates the maps with the trips
pdf("../maps/NESEt2kba_Trips_PB.pdf")
mapTrips(trips = NESE.trips, colony = colony)
dev.off()

mapTrips(trips = NESE.trips, colony = colony)

# Trips summaries
NESE.sumTrips <- tripSummary(trips = NESE.trips, colony = colony)
NESE.sumTrips


```

Kernel analysis

```{r kernel-analysis}
#NESE.trips$Longitude <- transform_longitude_vector(NESE.trips$Longitude)
NESE.tracks <- projectTracks(dataGroup = NESE.trips, projType = 'azim', custom=TRUE )

# Estimate the scale, h value
NESE.hVals <- findScale(
  tracks   = NESE.tracks,
  scaleARS = TRUE,
  sumTrips = NESE.sumTrips)

NESE.hVals

# Remove locations within 100 km of the colony
NESE.tracks <- NESE.tracks[NESE.tracks$ColDist > 100, ] # remove trip start and end points near colony

 # Kernel Density Estimates
NESE.KDE <- estSpaceUse(
  tracks = NESE.tracks, 
  scale = NESE.hVals$href, 
  levelUD = 50, 
  polyOut = TRUE 
  )

kde.fig <- mapKDE(KDE = NESE.KDE$UDPolygons, colony = colony)
print(kde.fig)
ggsave(filename = "../figures/kdeUB_PB.pdf",
       plot = kde.fig,
       device = cairo_pdf)


# Save the individuals UDs
st_write(NESE.KDE$UDPolygons, "../results/NESEUD50_PB_href.shp",append=FALSE)
```
UD analysis
```{r UD-analysis}


#tic()
NESE.repr <- repAssess(
  tracks    = NESE.tracks, 
  KDE       = NESE.KDE$KDE.Surface, 
  levelUD   = 50,
  iteration = 500)
#toc()

NESE.Site.1 <- findSite(
  KDE = NESE.KDE$KDE.Surface,
  represent = NESE.repr$out,
  levelUD = 50,
  popSize = 1800,     # 1800 individual adult females elephant seals at Año Nuevo
  polyOut =  TRUE
)

NESE.Site.2 <- findSite(
  KDE = NESE.KDE$KDE.Surface,
  represent = NESE.repr$out,
  levelUD = 50,
  popSize = 1800     # 1800 individual adult females elephant seals at Año Nuevo
  )


#Sitemap <- mapSite(NESE.Site.1, colony = colony)

mapSite(NESE.Site.2, colony = colony)

t2kba.1 <- raster(NESE.Site.2, layer = 1, values = TRUE)
t2kba.1[t2kba.1 == 0] <- NA

t2kba.2 <- raster(NESE.Site.2, layer = 2, values = TRUE)
t2kba.2[t2kba.2 == 0] <- NA

#Save the data frame
saveRDS(NESE.Site.2,'../results/NESEt2kba_PB.rds')
writeRaster(t2kba.1,'../results/t2kba1_PB.tif',overwrite=TRUE)
writeRaster(t2kba.2,'../results/t2kba2_PB.tif',overwrite=TRUE)



```


Create the maps
```{r create-the-maps}
library(stars)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)


#Load the raster created originally
t2kba.i <- read_stars('../results/t2kba1_PB.tif')
t2kba.i[t2kba.i==0] <- NA

# Read the coastline
coastline <- st_read('../data/GSHHS_shp/f/GSHHS_f_L1.shp')

#read map as a shapefile
coastline.p <- st_transform(coastline, st_crs(t2kba.i))
rstr.ext <- st_coordinates(t2kba.i)

map_limits <- c(-5702014.0,7534.8,-585362.4,3869809.3) # Set map limits for all figures

# read the 200m isobath
iso200 <- st_read('../data/Shelf/ETOPO2024_200m_NP.shp')
iso200.p <- st_transform(iso200, st_crs(t2kba.i))


# Turn colony coordinates into a sf
colony.p <- st_as_sf(colony, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
colony.p <- st_transform(colony.p, st_crs(t2kba.i))

# Generate graticules
graticules <- st_graticule(lon = seq(-180,180, 10),
                           lat = seq(-90,90, 10)) 
graticules.p <- st_transform(graticules, st_crs(t2kba.i))

# Generate tick labels
ticks <- as.data.frame(cbind(graticules.p$x_start,graticules.p$y_start))
colnames(ticks) <- c("lon", "lat")
ticks <-  st_as_sf(ticks, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
ticks.p <- st_transform(ticks, st_crs(t2kba.i))
ticks <- as.data.frame(st_coordinates(ticks.p))


x_ticks <- ticks$X[1:37]
x_labels <- c("180°","170°W","160°W","150°W","140°W","130°W","120°W","110°W","100°W",
              "90°W","80°W","70°W","60°W","50°W","40°W","30°W","20°W","10°W","0°",
              "10°E","20°E","30°E","40°E","50°E","60°E","70°E","80°E","90°E","100°E",
              "110°E","120°E","130°E","140°E","150°E","160°E","170°E","180°")

y_ticks <- ticks$Y[38:54]
y_labels <- c("80°S","70°S","60°S","50°S","40°S","30°S","20°S","10°S","0°",
              "10°N","20°N","30°N","40°N","50°N","60°N","70°N","80°N")


# Create map 
nese_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_stars(data = t2kba.i) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name ='No. Ind', na.value="transparent") +
  geom_sf(data = coastline.p, fill = 'grey55' ) + 
  geom_sf(data = iso200.p, color = "grey85", size = 0.4) + 
  geom_sf(data = colony.p, aes(geometry = geometry), 
          shape = 23, color = "black", fill = "darkorange3", size = 5) +
  lims(x = c(map_limits[1], map_limits[2]), y = c(map_limits[3], map_limits[4])) + 
  labs(x = 'Longitude (°)', y = 'Latitude (°)') +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "skyblue3",
                                colour = "skyblue3"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
         #annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3) +
  
  geom_sf(data = graticules.p, colour = "grey95", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed")
  
print(nese_plot)

ggsave(filename = "../figures/KBA_PBFemales.pdf",
       plot = nese_plot,
       device = cairo_pdf)





```
